mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stories (id, family_id, title, body, narrative_time, created_by, updated_by, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{familyId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{narrativeTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE stories SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, narrative_time = #{narrativeTime}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = #{expectedVersion} + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, family_id, title, body, narrative_time, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, version FROM stories WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, family_id, title, body, narrative_time, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, version FROM stories WHERE id = #{id} AND family_id = #{familyId}

SELECT s.id, s.family_id, s.title, s.body, s.narrative_time, s.created_by, s.updated_by, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.version FROM stories s INNER JOIN story_persons sp ON s.id = sp.story_id WHERE s.family_id = #{familyId} AND sp.person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
SELECT person_id FROM story_persons WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stories WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
